presets.name: Double High Protein Bowl
presets.blurb: Double chicken over light rice and black beans. 760 kcal, 81g protein.
presets.sourceNote: Composition and published figures from chipotle.com/lifestyle-bowls (fetched 2026-08-06). "Light" rice is a half portion and "extra" lettuce a double — both confirmed by summing to Chipotle's published totals for this bowl. Verified: 760 kcal / 81 g protein, exact.
